site.name: Alton Tunnel
overview: Alton Tunnel is a documented historic mine tunnel in western Boulder County, preserved in federal place-name mapping and the Nederland USGS topographic record.
moreHistory: USGS/GNIS-derived records identify Alton Tunnel as a Boulder County mine and place the named historic tunnel at approximately 39.9667, -105.5333. The mapped point identifies the historic tunnel locality without implying that a surviving portal has been field-verified or is accessible today.
